content.title: Albemarle Stock Rises After Big Pullback. What’s Behind the Lithium Miner’s Volatility?
content.summary: Albemarle  stock rose modestly Friday—a rare quiet day for a name that has become a picture of volatility in recent months.  Shares of the lithium miner were up 0.6% on Friday after dropping 7.4% on Thursday, snapping a nine-session winning streak.  Investors in the lithium miner should be pleased with their returns this year:  Albemarle  stock has gained 33%.
